title: Climate-Smart Agriculture in Southern Africa: Best Practices and Lessons Learned
abstract: This comprehensive guide presents best practices and lessons learned from climate-smart agriculture projects across Southern Africa. Based on collaborative research between GIZ, AfDB, and FAO, the publication provides practical guidance for policymakers, development practitioners, and farmers on implementing climate-resilient agricultural practices.

title: Africa Agricultural Outlook 2024: Transforming Food Systems for Resilience
abstract: The Africa Agricultural Outlook 2024 analyzes trends, challenges, and opportunities in African agriculture. This flagship joint publication by AfDB and FAO provides comprehensive analysis of agricultural transformation, food security, and sustainable development across the continent.
authors: Dr. John Kariuki (FAO Regional Representative for Africa)
Prof. Agnes Kalibata (Former Minister of Agriculture, Rwanda)

title: Scaling Up Climate-Smart Agriculture in Africa: A Multi-Partner Approach
abstract: This joint publication examines successful multi-partner collaboration models for scaling up climate-smart agriculture across Africa. Drawing on experiences from GIZ, FAO, and AfDB partnerships, it provides a framework for effective collaboration among development partners.
authors: Dr. Klaus Weber (GIZ Climate Agriculture Expert)
Dr. Agnes Matilda Kalibata (FAO Special Envoy for UN Food Systems Summit)
Dr. Jennifer Blanke (AfDB Vice President Agriculture, Human and Social Development)
department: AfDB Agriculture Division / GIZ Agriculture Programme / FAO Investment Centre

title: Public Financial Management Reform in Africa: GIZ-AfDB Partnership Experiences
abstract: This technical note documents lessons learned and best practices from GIZ-AfDB collaboration on public financial management reforms across African countries. It provides practical guidance for institutional strengthening and capacity building initiatives.
series: AfDB Governance and Public Management Series
authors: Dr. Emmanuel Pinto Moreira (AfDB Director, Governance)
Ms. Thoko Moyo (Ministry of Finance, Zambia)
department: AfDB Governance and Public Sector Management Division

title: Nutrition-Sensitive Agriculture: Evidence from FAO-AfDB Joint Projects
abstract: This policy brief presents evidence and lessons from FAO-AfDB joint projects on integrating nutrition into agricultural development. It demonstrates the effectiveness of nutrition-sensitive approaches in improving dietary diversity and reducing malnutrition.
department: AfDB Human Development Division / FAO Nutrition Division

title: African Economic Outlook 2024
abstract: The African Economic Outlook provides a comprehensive analysis of Africa's economic performance and prospects. This flagship publication includes analysis of macroeconomic trends, structural transformation, and sustainable development across all African countries.
authors: Dr. Kevin Chika Urama (AfDB Chief Economist)

title: Agricultural Value Chain Development: Lessons from GIZ-FAO-AfDB Collaboration
abstract: This working paper analyzes agricultural value chain development projects implemented through GIZ-FAO-AfDB partnerships. It provides insights on market linkages, value addition, and inclusive growth strategies.

title: Women in Agriculture: Closing the Gender Gap for Development
abstract: This sector report examines the role of women in African agriculture and strategies for closing gender gaps. It presents evidence-based recommendations for gender-responsive agricultural policies and programs.
department: AfDB Gender, Women and Civil Society Department
